parsed.explanation: Article 135 is not a dead letter: the dossier documents arrests (2019, 2020), state torture during investigation, confinement to psychiatric facilities, and impunity, with the 2022 code increasing severity and scope. It explicitly reaches a trans visitor whose documents record their birth sex — exposure the visitor cannot avoid, since no gender recognition exists and trans people are legally unacknowledged. Outing consequences are severe: interrogation, torture, imprisonment. No anti-discrimination law exists; the government rejects one; media are state-owned and no civil society operates, so there is no remedy or independent record — thin data here extrapolates from structural facts, not toward safety. No execution or presentation offence is documented, which keeps this above the extreme floor, but state-directed torture plus enforced criminalisation with no recourse places it well within severe risk.
